Introducing Saved Views, now available today for every team using our project management tool. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild the same setup twice. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, sorting by priority, or grouping work by assignee, you can save that configuration in a single click and return to it whenever you need it.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize dashboards for different projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters from scratch. This makes onboarding new teammates faster and keeps reporting consistent across the board.

We built Saved Views based on direct customer feedback, and we're rolling it out to help teams spend less time configuring and more time getting work done. Give it a try in your workspace today.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
